llm_request:
Please write 20 reviews of 100mi crypto platform based on the following description:

100mi is a platform that combines cryptocurrency and Blockchain Technology with Multilevel Marketing. Their vision is to create a global community of crypto enthusiasts who can benefit from their innovative products and services while earning passive income. The platform is designed to be simple, secure and transparent.

Products and services include:
- Decentralized Exchange: Allows users to trade cryptocurrencies directly with each other without intermediaries, with low fees and high liquidity
- Play-to-Earn Platform: Users can earn digital assets/tokens while playing games including gambling and prediction games
- Synthetic Derivatives Platform: Allows users to create and trade custom contracts based on market conditions without directly owning underlying assets
- Staking Program: Users can stake their native 100mi token to earn passive income and additional tokens
- Referral Program: Users earn commissions by inviting new members to join the platform

The platform is supported by experts in marketing, finance, blockchain development, legal affairs and customer support.

Please write 20 diverse reviews from different perspectives (new users, experienced crypto traders, MLM participants, etc.) highlighting various features and benefits of the platform.
